summary.text: Letisha Hinds is the Democratic candidate for Arkansas House of Representatives District 16 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She works in retail and says her campaign priorities are managing growth and infrastructure, improving public education and the cost of living.

paragraphs.text: Letisha Hinds earned a bachelor's degree from Arkansas State University in 2012, and her career experience includes working in retail.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a lifelong Arkansan raising her daughter in the state.

She listed three key campaign messages: supporting smart growth, including attention to traffic and stormwater drainage in District 16; improving education by investing in teachers and holding taxpayer-funded private schools to the same standard as other schools; and addressing the cost of living.
Hinds said she is personally passionate about public education.
